<script>
    (function() {
        var app = this;

        if (isEmpty(app.userData) && !getCookie('MKS.GTMAnonymousSession')) {
            anonymousUserData(delayedDataLayerInitialization);
        } else {
            delayedDataLayerInitialization();
        }

        function getInitialUserData() {
            var initialUserData = {};

            initialUserData.userID = getCookie('MKS.customerId') || '';
            initialUserData.loggedIn = getCookie('MKS.loggedIn') === 'true';
            initialUserData.internal = getCookie('MKS.internal') || '';
            initialUserData.viewedFlyer = getCookie('MKS.viewedFlyer') || '';

            if (initialUserData.loggedIn && !isEmpty(app.userData)) {
                initialUserData.userID = app.userData.customerId;
                initialUserData.viewedFlyer = (app.userData.viewedFlayer && app.userData.viewedFlayer.toString()) || '';
                initialUserData.internal = app.userData.internal.toString();
            }

            return initialUserData;
        }

        function delayedDataLayerInitialization() {
             setTimeout(function(){
                  coreDataLayerEvent();
             }, 1000);
        }

        function coreDataLayerEvent () {
            var userData = getInitialUserData() || {};

            window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];

            try {
                window.dataLayer.push({
                    event: 'dataLayer-initialized',
                    pageDetails: getPageDetails(),
                    sessionDetails: getSessionDetails(userData),
                    userDetails: getUserDetails(userData)
                });
            } catch (e) {
                console.error('glb-core-data-layer : ' + e);
            }
        }

        function _getPageType() {
            var pageType = app.analyticsObject.pageType;
            if (pageType === 'Page Not Found Page') {
                pageType = 'error - 404 - Page Not Found';
            }
            return pageType;
        }

        function getPageDetails() {
            var pageDetails = {
                'banner': 'marks',
                'language': 'en' === 'fr' ? 'french' : 'english',
                'responsiveDesignBreakpointVersion': getBreakPointVersion(),
                'siteVersion': 'a323e2f65fdf265f64a7321344a1d698de94405a',
                'searchEngine': sessionStorage.getItem('searchEngine') || '',
                'pageType': _getPageType(),
                'pageURL': getPageUrl()
            };

            function getBreakPointVersion () {
                return Math.max(document.documentElement.clientWidth, window.innerWidth || 0) + 'px';
            }

            function getPageUrl() {
                var origin = window.location.origin;
                var path = window.location.pathname;
                var hash = window.location.hash;
                var pagesRegExp = /(\/search|\/store-locator)\.html/;

                if (pagesRegExp.test(path) && hash.length) {
                    hash = hash.slice(1, hash.length).replace(/\+/g, '%20');
                    path += '?' + hash;
                }

                return origin + path;
            }

            return pageDetails;
        }

        function getUserDetails(userData) {
            return {
                'userID': userData.userID,
                'loyaltyStatus': '',
                'viewedFlyer': userData.viewedFlyer,
                'ctfsMember': ''
            };
        }

        function getSessionDetails (userData) {
            var headerCart = getCookie('MKS.headerCart');
            var cartID = '';
            if(headerCart) {
                 cartID = JSON.parse(headerCart).code || '';
            }

            return {
                'cartID': cartID,
                'storeID': '',
                'storeName': '',
                'userDeclaredStoreID': '',
                'userDeclaredStoreName': '',
                'loggedIn':  userData.loggedIn.toString(),
                'internal':  userData.internal,
                'viewFlyer': getCookie('MKS.viewFlyer') || 'false'
            };
        }

        function getCookie(name) {
            var matches = document.cookie.match(new RegExp(
            "(?:^|; )" + name.replace(/([\.$?*|{}\(\)\[\]\\\/\+^])/g, '\$1') + "=([^;]*)"
            ));

            return matches ? decodeURIComponent(matches[1]) : undefined;
        }

        function setCookie(name, value) {
            value = encodeURIComponent(value);

<script id="add-custom-css" type="text/javascript">
	    (function(dataJSON) {

	        var makeAsync = requestAnimationFrame || mozRequestAnimationFrame ||
	        webkitRequestAnimationFrame || msRequestAnimationFrame;

	        if (makeAsync) {
	            makeAsync(function() { window.setTimeout(loadCustomStyles, 0); });
	        } else {
	            window.addEventListener('load', loadCustomStyles);
	        }

	        function loadCustomStyles() {
	            dataJSON = dataJSON || '';
	            var cssUrl = [],
	                customStyles = {headStyle: [], bodyStyle: []},
	                includePlaces = {headStyle: 'head', bodyStyle: 'body'},
	                stylesBodyWrapper = document.createElement('div');

	            try {
	                cssUrl = JSON.parse(dataJSON);
	            }catch(err) {
	                console.log('>>> Error parse data for custom css', err);
	                return;
	            }

	            cssUrl.reduce(function(temp, url) {
	                var cssLinkTag = document.createElement('link');
	                cssLinkTag.rel = 'stylesheet';
	                cssLinkTag.type = 'text/css';
	                cssLinkTag.href = url.src + '?v=' + 'a323e2f65fdf265f64a7321344a1d698de94405a';
	                (url.place === includePlaces.headStyle) ? temp.headStyle.push(cssLinkTag) : temp.bodyStyle.push(cssLinkTag);
	                return temp;
	            }, customStyles);

	            (customStyles.headStyle.length) ? customStyles.headStyle.forEach(document.head.appendChild.bind(document.head)) : null;

	            if(customStyles.bodyStyle.length) {
	                customStyles.bodyStyle.forEach(stylesBodyWrapper.appendChild.bind(stylesBodyWrapper));
	                document.body.appendChild(stylesBodyWrapper);
	            }

	        }

	    })('[{"src":"/content/dam/marks/stylesheets/pencil-ad-top__close.css","place":"head"},{"src":"/content/dam/marks/stylesheets/2019-wk43-homepage.css","place":"head"},{"src":"/content/dam/marks/stylesheets/all-css-footer-header_V4.css","place":"head"},{"src":"/content/dam/marks/stylesheets/sale-events.css","place":"head"},{"src":"/content/dam/marks/stylesheets/generic-omc-banner-style.css","place":"head"},{"src":"/content/dam/marks/stylesheets/footer-with-ea-logo.css","place":"head"},{"src":"/content/dam/marks/stylesheets/custom-temp-nav.css","place":"head"}]');

<script id="add-custom-js" type="text/javascript">
	    (function(dataJSON) {
	        dataJSON = dataJSON || '';
	        var scriptsUrl = [];
	        var injectionTypes = ['async', 'defer'];

	        try {
	            scriptsUrl = JSON.parse(dataJSON);
	        }catch(err) {
	            console.log('>>> Error parse data for custom js', err);
	            return;
	        }

	        scriptsUrl.forEach(loadJS);

	        function loadJS(options) {
	            var script = document.createElement('script');
	            script.type = 'text/javascript';

	            injectionTypes.forEach(function(injectionType) {
	                if(JSON.stringify(options).indexOf(injectionType) !== -1) {
	                    script[injectionType] = true;
	                }else {
	                    script[injectionType] = false;
	                }
	            });

	            script.onload = function() {
	                (!!options.callback) ? window[options.callback]() : null;
	            };

	            script.onerror = function(error) {
	                console.log('>>>> Error on load custom JS', options.src);
	            };

	            script.src = options.src + '?v=' + 'a323e2f65fdf265f64a7321344a1d698de94405a';

	            (options.place) ? document[options.place].appendChild(script) : null;
	        }

	    })('[{"src":"/content/dam/marks/scripts/final-insert-generic-footer-triangle-legal-en-v1.js","place":"head","injectionType":"default"}]');
	</script>

        document.body.appendChild(div);

    var raf = requestAnimationFrame || mozRequestAnimationFrame ||
    webkitRequestAnimationFrame || msRequestAnimationFrame;

    if (raf) {
    raf(function() { window.setTimeout(loadStyles, 0); });
    } else {
    window.addEventListener('load', loadStyles);
    }
